reviews.title: Made our pastor happy.
reviews.comment: Our pastor doesn't like to use the headset microphone I had so I purchased this and it works great. Audio is clear and loud enough for the hard-of-hearng without getting feedback.
reviews.author: Phil Gould

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.comment: I purchased this to replace a defective lavalier, however it is not sensitive enough to pick up your voice unless you hold it directly in front of your mouth.
reviews.author: HEW
